inductive EdgeQuality where
  | collapsed
  | entangled
  | superposition
  | coherent
deriving BEq, Repr, Inhabited

def EdgeQuality.toString : EdgeQuality → String
  | .collapsed => "collapsed"
  | .entangled => "entangled"
  | .superposition => "superposition"

structure QuantumState where
  alpha : Float
  beta : Float
  gamma : Float
  delta : Float
  entanglement_degree : Float
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def QuantumState.init (a b c d e : Float) : QuantumState := { alpha := a, beta := b, gamma := c, delta := d, entanglement_degree := e }

def QuantumState.probability (self : QuantumState) : Float :=
  self.alpha * self.alpha + self.beta * self.beta + self.gamma * self.gamma + self.delta * self.delta

def QuantumState.magnitude (self : QuantumState) : Float :=
  Float.sqrt (self.probability self)

def QuantumState.clone (self : QuantumState) : QuantumState := self

abbrev Timestamp := Int

def MIN_TIMESTAMP : Timestamp := Int.minValue
def MAX_TIMESTAMP : Timestamp := Int.maxValue

structure NodeVersion where
  version : Nat
  timestamp : Timestamp
  data : QuantumState
  properties : HashMap String String
  allocator : Unit
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def NodeVersion.init (allocator : Unit) (version_num : Nat) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) (quantum_data : QuantumState) : NodeVersion :=
  { version := version_num, timestamp := timestamp_ns, data := quantum_data, properties := HashMap.empty, allocator := allocator }

def NodeVersion.init_with_properties (allocator : Unit) (version_num : Nat) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) (quantum_data : QuantumState) (props : List (String × String)) : NodeVersion :=
  let base := NodeVersion.init allocator version_num timestamp_ns quantum_data
  props.foldl (fun v (k, val) => v.setProperty k val) base

def NodeVersion.deinit (self : NodeVersion) : Unit := ()

def NodeVersion.clone (self : NodeVersion) (allocator : Unit) : NodeVersion :=
  { self with properties := self.properties.clone }

def NodeVersion.setProperty (self : NodeVersion) (key value : String) : Except String NodeVersion :=
  .ok { self with properties := self.properties.insert key value }

def NodeVersion.getProperty (self : NodeVersion) (key : String) : Option String :=
  self.properties.find? key

def NodeVersion.removeProperty (self : NodeVersion) (key : String) : NodeVersion :=
  { self with properties := self.properties.erase key }

def NodeVersion.propertyCount (self : NodeVersion) : Nat :=
  self.properties.size

def NodeVersion.probability (self : NodeVersion) : Float :=
  self.data.probability

def NodeVersion.magnitude (self : NodeVersion) : Float :=
  self.data.magnitude

structure TemporalNode where
  node_id : String
  versions : Array NodeVersion
  current_version : Nat
  created_at : Timestamp
  last_modified : Timestamp
  allocator : Unit
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def TemporalNode.init (alloc : Unit) (id : String) (initial_state : QuantumState) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalNode :=
  .ok {
    node_id := id,
    versions := #[NodeVersion.init alloc 0 timestamp_ns initial_state],
    current_version := 0,
    created_at := timestamp_ns,
    last_modified := timestamp_ns,
    allocator := alloc
  }

def TemporalNode.deinit (self : TemporalNode) : Unit := ()

def TemporalNode.addVersion (self : TemporalNode) (state : QuantumState) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalNode :=
  if self.versions.isEmpty then .error "No versions"
  else
    let last := self.versions[self.versions.size - 1]!
    if timestamp_ns < last.timestamp then .error "TimeTravelNotAllowed"
    else
      let new_version := NodeVersion.init self.allocator self.versions.size timestamp_ns state
      .ok {
        versions := self.versions.push new_version,
        current_version := self.versions.size,
        last_modified := timestamp_ns
      }

def TemporalNode.addVersionWithProperties (self : TemporalNode) (state : QuantumState) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) (props : List (String × String)) : Except String TemporalNode :=
  if self.versions.isEmpty then .error "No versions"
  else
    let last := self.versions[self.versions.size - 1]!
    if timestamp_ns < last.timestamp then .error "TimeTravelNotAllowed"
    else
      let base_version := NodeVersion.init self.allocator self.versions.size timestamp_ns state
      let new_version := NodeVersion.init_with_properties self.allocator self.versions.size timestamp_ns state props
      .ok {
        versions := self.versions.push new_version,
        current_version := self.versions.size,
        last_modified := timestamp_ns
      }

def TemporalNode.getVersion (self : TemporalNode) (version_num : Nat) : Option NodeVersion :=
  self.versions.get? version_num

def TemporalNode.getVersionMut (self : TemporalNode) (version_num : Nat) : Option NodeVersion :=
  self.getVersion version_num

def TemporalNode.getCurrentVersion (self : TemporalNode) : Option NodeVersion :=
  self.getVersion self.current_version

def TemporalNode.getCurrentVersionMut (self : TemporalNode) : Option NodeVersion :=
  self.getCurrentVersion

def TemporalNode.getVersionAt (self : TemporalNode) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Option NodeVersion :=
  let rec loop (left : Nat) (right : Nat) (result : Option NodeVersion) : Option NodeVersion :=
    if left > right then result
    else
      let mid := left + (right - left) / 2
      let version := self.versions[mid]!
      if version.timestamp ≤ timestamp_ns then
        loop (mid + 1) right (some version)
      else
        if mid = 0 then result
        else loop left (mid - 1) result
  loop 0 (self.versions.size - 1) none

def TemporalNode.rollback (self : TemporalNode) (target_version : Nat) : Except String TemporalNode :=
  if target_version ≥ self.versions.size then .error "InvalidVersion"
  else
    let new_versions := self.versions.shrink (target_version + 1)
    let ts := match new_versions.get? target_version with
      | some v => v.timestamp
      | none => self.last_modified
    .ok { self with versions := new_versions, current_version := target_version, last_modified := ts }

def TemporalNode.rollbackToTime (self : TemporalNode) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalNode :=
  match self.getVersionAt timestamp_ns with
  | some v => self.rollback v.version
  | none => .error "VersionNotFound"

def TemporalNode.versionCount (self : TemporalNode) : Nat :=
  self.versions.size

def TemporalNode.getVersionHistory (self : TemporalNode) (allocator : Unit) : List Nat :=
  List.range self.versions.size

def TemporalNode.getVersionsInRange (self : TemporalNode) (start_time end_time : Timestamp) : List Nat :=
  self.versions.toList.mapIdx (fun i v => (i, v)) |>.filter (fun p => start_time ≤ p.2.timestamp && p.2.timestamp ≤ end_time) |>.map (fun p => p.1)

def TemporalNode.getCurrentState (self : TemporalNode) : Option QuantumState :=
  (self.getCurrentVersion).map (fun v => v.data)

def TemporalNode.clone (self : TemporalNode) (allocator : Unit) : Except String TemporalNode :=
  let init_st := QuantumState.init 0 0 0 0 0
  match TemporalNode.init allocator self.node_id init_st self.created_at with
  | .ok new_node =>
    let mut new_node := { new_node with versions := #[] }
    new_node := { new_node with current_version := self.current_version, created_at := self.created_at, last_modified := self.last_modified }
    let mut new_versions : Array NodeVersion := #[]
    for v in self.versions do
      new_versions := new_versions.push (v.clone allocator)
    .ok { new_node with versions := new_versions }
  | .error e => .error e

structure TemporalEdge where
  edge_id : String
  source : String
  target : String
  versions : Array EdgeVersion
  current_version : Nat
  valid_from : Timestamp
  valid_to : Timestamp
  created_at : Timestamp
  last_modified : Timestamp
  allocator : Unit
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def TemporalEdge.init (alloc : Unit) (id source target : String) (initial_weight : Float) (initial_quality : EdgeQuality) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalEdge :=
  .ok {
    edge_id := id,
    source := source,
    target := target,
    versions := #[EdgeVersion.init alloc 0 timestamp_ns initial_weight initial_quality],
    current_version := 0,
    valid_from := timestamp_ns,
    valid_to := MAX_TIMESTAMP,
    created_at := timestamp_ns,
    last_modified := timestamp_ns,
    allocator := alloc
  }

def TemporalEdge.initWithTimeRange (allocator : Unit) (id source target : String) (initial_weight : Float) (initial_quality : EdgeQuality) (from_ts to_ts : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalEdge :=
  match TemporalEdge.init allocator id source target initial_weight initial_quality from_ts with
  | .ok base => .ok { base with valid_to := to_ts }
  | .error e => .error e

def TemporalEdge.deinit (self : TemporalEdge) : Unit := ()

def TemporalEdge.isValidAt (self : TemporalEdge) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Bool :=
  timestamp_ns ≥ self.valid_from && timestamp_ns ≤ self.valid_to

def TemporalEdge.setValidityRange (self : TemporalEdge) (from to_ : Timestamp) : TemporalEdge :=
  { self with valid_from := from, valid_to := to_ }

def TemporalEdge.invalidate (self : TemporalEdge) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : TemporalEdge :=
  { self with valid_to := timestamp_ns }

def TemporalEdge.addVersion (self : TemporalEdge) (weight : Float) (quality : EdgeQuality) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalEdge :=
  if self.versions.isEmpty then .error "No versions"
  else
    let last := self.versions[self.versions.size - 1]!
    if timestamp_ns < last.timestamp then .error "TimeTravelNotAllowed"
    else
      let new_version := EdgeVersion.init self.allocator self.versions.size timestamp_ns weight quality
      .ok {
        versions := self.versions.push new_version,
        current_version := self.versions.size,
        last_modified := timestamp_ns
      }

def TemporalEdge.getVersion (self : TemporalEdge) (version_num : Nat) : Option EdgeVersion :=
  self.versions.get? version_num

def TemporalEdge.getVersionMut (self : TemporalEdge) (version_num : Nat) : Option EdgeVersion :=
  self.getVersion version_num

def TemporalEdge.getCurrentVersion (self : TemporalEdge) : Option EdgeVersion :=
  self.getVersion self.current_version

def TemporalEdge.getVersionAt (self : TemporalEdge) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Option EdgeVersion :=
  if !self.isValidAt timestamp_ns then none
  else
    let rec loop (left : Nat) (right : Nat) (result : Option EdgeVersion) : Option EdgeVersion :=
      if left > right then result
      else
        let mid := left + (right - left) / 2
        let version := self.versions[mid]!
        if version.timestamp ≤ timestamp_ns then
          loop (mid + 1) right (some version)
        else
          if mid = 0 then result
          else loop left (mid - 1) result
    loop 0 (self.versions.size - 1) none

def TemporalEdge.rollback (self : TemporalEdge) (target_version : Nat) : Except String TemporalEdge :=
  if target_version ≥ self.versions.size then .error "InvalidVersion"
  else
    let new_versions := self.versions.shrink (target_version + 1)
    let ts := match new_versions.get? target_version with
      | some v => v.timestamp
      | none => self.last_modified
    .ok { self with versions := new_versions, current_version := target_version, last_modified := ts }

def TemporalEdge.versionCount (self : TemporalEdge) : Nat :=
  self.versions.size

def TemporalEdge.getEdgeKey (self : TemporalEdge) : EdgeKey :=
  { source := self.source, target := self.target }

def TemporalEdge.getCurrentWeight (self : TemporalEdge) : Float :=
  match self.getCurrentVersion with
  | some v => v.weight
  | none => 0.0

def TemporalEdge.getCurrentQuality (self : TemporalEdge) : EdgeQuality :=
  match self.getCurrentVersion with
  | some v => v.quality
  | none => .collapsed

def TemporalEdge.clone (self : TemporalEdge) (allocator : Unit) : Except String TemporalEdge :=
  match TemporalEdge.init allocator self.edge_id self.source self.target (self.getCurrentWeight) (self.getCurrentQuality) self.created_at with
  | .ok new_edge =>
    let mut new_edge := { new_edge with versions := #[] }
    new_edge := { new_edge with current_version := self.current_version, valid_from := self.valid_from, valid_to := self.valid_to, last_modified := self.last_modified }
    let mut new_versions : Array EdgeVersion := #[]
    for v in self.versions do
      new_versions := new_versions.push (v.clone allocator)
    .ok { new_edge with versions := new_versions }
  | .error e => .error e

structure TemporalQueryResult where
  nodes : List TemporalNode
  edges : List TemporalEdge
  query_time : Timestamp
  allocator : Unit
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def TemporalQueryResult.init (allocator : Unit) (query_time : Timestamp) : TemporalQueryResult :=
  { nodes := [], edges := [], query_time := query_time, allocator := allocator }

def TemporalQueryResult.deinit (self : TemporalQueryResult) : Unit := ()

def TemporalQueryResult.nodeCount (self : TemporalQueryResult) : Nat :=
  self.nodes.length

def TemporalQueryResult.edgeCount (self : TemporalQueryResult) : Nat :=
  self.edges.length

def NodeFilterFn := TemporalNode → Bool
def EdgeFilterFn := TemporalEdge → Bool

structure TemporalQuery where
  start_time : Timestamp
  end_time : Timestamp
  node_filter : Option NodeFilterFn
  edge_filter : Option EdgeFilterFn
  include_invalidated_edges : Bool
  allocator : Unit
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def TemporalQuery.init (allocator : Unit) (start end_ : Timestamp) : TemporalQuery :=
  {
    start_time := start,
    end_time := end_,
    node_filter := none,
    edge_filter := none,
    include_invalidated_edges := false,
    allocator := allocator
  }

def TemporalQuery.initWithFilters (allocator : Unit) (start end_ : Timestamp) (node_filter : Option NodeFilterFn) (edge_filter : Option EdgeFilterFn) : TemporalQuery :=
  {
    start_time := start,
    end_time := end_,
    node_filter := node_filter,
    edge_filter := edge_filter,
    include_invalidated_edges := false,
    allocator := allocator
  }

def TemporalQuery.setNodeFilter (self : TemporalQuery) (filter : NodeFilterFn) : TemporalQuery :=
  { self with node_filter := some filter }

def TemporalQuery.setEdgeFilter (self : TemporalQuery) (filter : EdgeFilterFn) : TemporalQuery :=
  { self with edge_filter := some filter }

def TemporalQuery.setIncludeInvalidatedEdges (self : TemporalQuery) (include : Bool) : TemporalQuery :=
  { self with include_invalidated_edges := include }

def TemporalQuery.nodeMatchesTimeRange (self : TemporalQuery) (node : TemporalNode) : Bool :=
  node.created_at ≤ self.end_time && node.last_modified ≥ self.start_time

def TemporalQuery.edgeMatchesTimeRange (self : TemporalQuery) (edge : TemporalEdge) : Bool :=
  if !self.include_invalidated_edges && edge.valid_to < self.start_time then false
  else edge.created_at ≤ self.end_time && (edge.valid_to ≥ self.start_time || self.include_invalidated_edges)

def TemporalQuery.execute (self : TemporalQuery) (graph : TemporalGraph) : Except String TemporalQueryResult :=
  let mut res_nodes : List TemporalNode := []
  for (_, node) in graph.nodes do
    if self.nodeMatchesTimeRange node then
      match self.node_filter with
      | some f => if f node then res_nodes := node :: res_nodes
      | none => res_nodes := node :: res_nodes
  
  let mut res_edges : List TemporalEdge := []
  for (_, edge) in graph.edges do
    if self.edgeMatchesTimeRange edge then
      match self.edge_filter with
      | some f => if f edge then res_edges := edge :: res_edges
      | none => res_edges := edge :: res_edges
  
  .ok { nodes := res_nodes.reverse, edges := res_edges.reverse, query_time := self.end_time, allocator := self.allocator }

structure TemporalGraph where
  nodes : HashMap String TemporalNode
  edges : HashMap EdgeKey TemporalEdge
  current_time : Timestamp
  snapshots : Array GraphSnapshot
  history : Array HistoryEntry
  next_snapshot_id : Nat
  next_edge_id : Nat
  allocator : Unit
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def TemporalGraph.init (allocator : Unit) : TemporalGraph :=
  {
    nodes := HashMap.empty,
    edges := HashMap.empty,
    current_time := 0,
    snapshots := #[],
    history := #[],
    next_snapshot_id := 0,
    next_edge_id := 0,
    allocator := allocator
  }

def TemporalGraph.initWithTime (allocator : Unit) (initial_time : Timestamp) : TemporalGraph :=
  let g := TemporalGraph.init allocator
  { g with current_time := initial_time }

def TemporalGraph.deinit (self : TemporalGraph) : Unit := ()

def TemporalGraph.setCurrentTime (self : TemporalGraph) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : TemporalGraph :=
  { self with current_time := timestamp_ns }

def TemporalGraph.advanceTime (self : TemporalGraph) (delta_ns : Timestamp) : TemporalGraph :=
  let new_time := self.current_time + delta_ns
  { self with current_time := if new_time > self.current_time then new_time else MAX_TIMESTAMP }

def TemporalGraph.getCurrentTime (self : TemporalGraph) : Timestamp :=
  self.current_time

def TemporalGraph.addNode (self : TemporalGraph) (node_id : String) (initial_state : QuantumState) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  self.addNodeAtTime node_id initial_state self.current_time

def TemporalGraph.addNodeAtTime (self : TemporalGraph) (node_id : String) (initial_state : QuantumState) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  if self.nodes.contains node_id then .error "NodeAlreadyExists"
  else
    match TemporalNode.init self.allocator node_id initial_state timestamp_ns with
    | .ok node => .ok { self with nodes := self.nodes.insert node_id node }
    | .error e => .error e

def TemporalGraph.addEdge (self : TemporalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) (weight : Float) (quality : EdgeQuality) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  self.addEdgeAtTime source_id target_id weight quality self.current_time

def TemporalGraph.addEdgeAtTime (self : TemporalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) (weight : Float) (quality : EdgeQuality) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  let lookup_key := { source := source_id, target := target_id }
  if self.edges.contains lookup_key then .error "EdgeAlreadyExists"
  else
    let edge_id := s!"edge_{self.next_edge_id}_{source_id}_{target_id}"
    match TemporalEdge.init self.allocator edge_id source_id target_id weight quality timestamp_ns with
    | .ok edge => 
      .ok {
        edges := self.edges.insert lookup_key edge,
        next_edge_id := self.next_edge_id + 1
      }
    | .error e => .error e

def TemporalGraph.addEdgeWithTimeRange (self : TemporalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) (weight : Float) (quality : EdgeQuality) (valid_from valid_to : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  let lookup_key := { source := source_id, target := target_id }
  if self.edges.contains lookup_key then .error "EdgeAlreadyExists"
  else
    let edge_id := s!"edge_{self.next_edge_id}_{source_id}_{target_id}"
    match TemporalEdge.initWithTimeRange self.allocator edge_id source_id target_id weight quality valid_from valid_to with
    | .ok edge => 
      .ok {
        edges := self.edges.insert lookup_key edge,
        next_edge_id := self.next_edge_id + 1
      }
    | .error e => .error e

def TemporalGraph.updateNode (self : TemporalGraph) (node_id : String) (new_state : QuantumState) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  self.updateNodeAtTime node_id new_state self.current_time

def TemporalGraph.updateNodeAtTime (self : TemporalGraph) (node_id : String) (new_state : QuantumState) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  match self.nodes.find? node_id with
  | some node =>
    match node.addVersion new_state timestamp_ns with
    | .ok new_node =>
      let new_nodes := self.nodes.insert node_id new_node
      let history_entry := HistoryEntry.init self.allocator timestamp_ns .update .node node_id node.current_version new_node.current_version
      .ok { self with nodes := new_nodes, history := self.history.push history_entry }
    | .error e => .error e
  | none => .error "NodeNotFound"

def TemporalGraph.updateEdge (self : TemporalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) (new_weight : Float) (new_quality : EdgeQuality) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  self.updateEdgeAtTime source_id target_id new_weight new_quality self.current_time

def TemporalGraph.updateEdgeAtTime (self : TemporalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) (new_weight : Float) (new_quality : EdgeQuality) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  let lookup_key := { source := source_id, target := target_id }
  match self.edges.find? lookup_key with
  | some edge =>
    match edge.addVersion new_weight new_quality timestamp_ns with
    | .ok new_edge =>
      let new_edges := self.edges.insert lookup_key new_edge
      let history_entry := HistoryEntry.init self.allocator timestamp_ns .update .edge edge.edge_id edge.current_version new_edge.current_version
      .ok { self with edges := new_edges, history := self.history.push history_entry }
    | .error e => .error e
  | none => .error "EdgeNotFound"

def TemporalGraph.invalidateEdge (self : TemporalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  self.invalidateEdgeAtTime source_id target_id self.current_time

def TemporalGraph.invalidateEdgeAtTime (self : TemporalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  let lookup_key := { source := source_id, target := target_id }
  match self.edges.find? lookup_key with
  | some edge =>
    let new_edge := edge.invalidate timestamp_ns
    let new_edges := self.edges.insert lookup_key new_edge
    let history_entry := HistoryEntry.init self.allocator timestamp_ns .invalidate .edge edge.edge_id edge.current_version edge.current_version

  if !self.isValidAt timestamp_ns then none
  else
    let rec loop (left : Nat) (right : Nat) (result : Option EdgeVersion) : Option EdgeVersion :=
      if left > right then result
      else
        let mid := left + (right - left) / 2
        let version := self.versions[mid]!
        if version.timestamp ≤ timestamp_ns then
          loop (mid + 1) right (some version)
        else
          if mid = 0 then result
          else loop left (mid - 1) result
    loop 0 (self.versions.size - 1) none

def TemporalEdge.rollback (self : TemporalEdge) (target_version : Nat) : Except String TemporalEdge :=
  if target_version ≥ self.versions.size then .error "InvalidVersion"
  else
    let new_versions := self.versions.shrink (target_version + 1)
    let ts := match new_versions.get? target_version with
      | some v => v.timestamp
      | none => self.last_modified
    .ok { self with versions := new_versions, current_version := target_version, last_modified := ts }

def TemporalEdge.clone (self : TemporalEdge) (allocator : Unit) : Except String TemporalEdge :=
  match TemporalEdge.init allocator self.edge_id self.source self.target (self.getCurrentWeight) (self.getCurrentQuality) self.created_at with
  | .ok new_edge =>
    let mut new_edge := { new_edge with versions := #[] }
    new_edge := { new_edge with current_version := self.current_version, valid_from := self.valid_from, valid_to := self.valid_to, last_modified := self.last_modified }
    let mut new_versions : Array EdgeVersion := #[]

def TemporalQuery.execute (self : TemporalQuery) (graph : TemporalGraph) : Except String TemporalQueryResult :=
  let mut res_nodes : List TemporalNode := []
  for (_, node) in graph.nodes do
    if self.nodeMatchesTimeRange node then
      match self.node_filter with
      | some f => if f node then res_nodes := node :: res_nodes
      | none => res_nodes := node :: res_nodes
  
  let mut res_edges : List TemporalEdge := []
  for (_, edge) in graph.edges do
    if self.edgeMatchesTimeRange edge then
      match self.edge_filter with
      | some f => if f edge then res_edges := edge :: res_edges
      | none => res_edges := edge :: res_edges
  
  .ok { nodes := res_nodes.reverse, edges := res_edges.reverse, query_time := self.end_time, allocator := self.allocator }

def TemporalGraph.createSnapshotAtTime (self : TemporalGraph) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  let snapshot_id := self.next_snapshot_id
  let mut snapshot := GraphSnapshot.init self.allocator snapshot_id timestamp_ns
  for (node_id, node) in self.nodes do
    match node.getVersionAt timestamp_ns with
    | some v => snapshot := snapshot.recordNodeVersion node_id v.version
    | none => ()
  for (key, edge) in self.edges do
    if edge.isValidAt timestamp_ns then
      match edge.getVersionAt timestamp_ns with
      | some v => snapshot := snapshot.recordEdgeVersion key v.version
      | none => ()
  let history_entry := HistoryEntry.init self.allocator timestamp_ns .create .snapshot "snapshot" none snapshot_id
  .ok {
    snapshots := self.snapshots.push snapshot,
    history := self.history.push history_entry,
    next_snapshot_id := self.next_snapshot_id + 1
  }

def TemporalGraph.restoreSnapshot (self : TemporalGraph) (snapshot_id : Nat) : Except String TemporalGraph :=
  match self.getSnapshot snapshot_id with
  | some snapshot =>
    let mut new_nodes := self.nodes
    let mut nodes_to_remove : List String := []
    for (node_id, node) in self.nodes do
      match snapshot.getNodeVersion node_id with
      | some target_version =>
        match node.rollback target_version with
        | .ok n => new_nodes := new_nodes.insert node_id n
        | .error e => return .error e
      | none =>
        if node.created_at > snapshot.timestamp then
          nodes_to_remove := node_id :: nodes_to_remove
    
    for nid in nodes_to_remove do
      new_nodes := new_nodes.erase nid

    let mut new_edges := self.edges
    let mut edges_to_remove : List EdgeKey := []
    for (key, edge) in self.edges do
      match snapshot.getEdgeVersion key with
      | some target_version =>
        match edge.rollback target_version with
        | .ok e => new_edges := new_edges.insert key e
        | .error e => return .error e
      | none =>
        if edge.created_at > snapshot.timestamp then
          edges_to_remove := key :: edges_to_remove

    for ek in edges_to_remove do
      new_edges := new_edges.erase ek

    let history_entry := HistoryEntry.init self.allocator self.current_time .rollback .snapshot "snapshot_restore" none snapshot_id
    .ok { self with nodes := new_nodes, edges := new_edges, history := self.history.push history_entry }
  | none => .error "SnapshotNotFound"

theorem addVersion_increases_count (node : TemporalNode) (state : QuantumState) (t : Timestamp) (h : t ≥ node.versions[node.versions.size - 1]!.timestamp) : (Except.map (fun n => n.versions.size) (node.addVersion state t)) = .ok (node.versions.size + 1) := by

theorem getVersionAt_finds_latest (node : TemporalNode) (t : Timestamp) : ∀ v, node.getVersionAt t = some v → v.timestamp ≤ t ∧ ∀ w ∈ node.versions, w.timestamp > t → w.version < v.version := by
  intro v h_find
  let rec helper (left right : Nat) (res : Option NodeVersion) : (left > right → res = none) ∧ (∃ r, res = some r → r.timestamp ≤ t ∧ (∀ w ∈ node.versions, w.timestamp > t → w.version < r.version)) := by

  sorry
